name: Arihara Satoru
source:
Satoru is an orphan who was adopted by Arihara Ryunosuke back when he was still a kid. Nanami, who was likewise adopted by their dad, is his non-blood-related sister.

He currently lives as a normal school student, but in truth, he works for his dad's organization as a secret agent.

[From [url=http://riddle.nekonyansoft.com/character.html]NekoNyan[/url]]
